reason: The README documents three user-facing tools for image recognition, image generation or transformation, and listing configured vision providers through external APIs, with generated images saved locally and optionally served over a local HTTP endpoint.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于外部模型 API 的图像识别、图像生成与图像变换工具，并支持保存和展示生成的图片。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness tools for image recognition, image generation, and image transformation through configured external model APIs, with support for saving and displaying generated images.

capabilities: Calls configured external vision and image-generation APIs
Reads local image files or remote image URLs for recognition
Writes generated images to the configured filesystem location
Serves generated images through an optional local HTTP server
